title: Within-stance force centroid does not establish added Parkinson discrimination across public gait datasets
abstract: Normalized within-stance force impulse centroid did not establish incremental Parkinson discrimination in exploratory gaitndd-to-gaitpdb transfer beyond demographics, speed, stride/stance summaries, swing asymmetry, coordination and peak timing. Among 163 target records, baseline/augmented log loss was 0.631141/0.634443; paired gain -0.003302, conditional95% interval [-0.008478, 0.001919]; AUC 0.738212/0.730098. Joint source/target refitting intervals span zero in both directions. This is a detector- and model-specific negative result, not equivalence or evidence against physiological force-shape information.
